facts.text: Mississippi Valley State University's home football venue, Rice–Totten Stadium, was renamed in 2000 in honor of former Delta Devils standouts Jerry Rice and Willie Totten.

sources.quote: In 2000, the stadium was renamed Rice–Totten Stadium in honor of former Delta Devils standouts Jerry Rice and Willie Totten.
